thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate detected in production (api-gateway) for service 'inference-gateway'. Severity=P1. Paging @oncall for incidents.

alice: saw a spike starting ~10:32 UTC — errors are primarily 502/504 and some 503. Dashboards show a big spike in 5xx token errors from the LB tier.

brian: confirming 5xx spikes on /v1/generate routes. Clients reporting timeouts too. Error rate up ~18% over baseline.

charlie: attaching a quick curl to one backend via gateway LB (hit a 502):

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/2 502
server: envoy
date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 10:34:11 GMT
content-length: 0

```

alice: envoy upstream logs show repeated 503 from shard pool A, then gateway retries immediately send more traffic and we see cascades.

observability-bot: Relevant metrics snapshot:
- LB 5xx rate: 18% (baseline 0.6%)
- avg latency: 1.4s -> 2.8s
- envoy cluster upstream_rq_5xx: spike from 10/min -> 120/min
- retry budget saturation: true

charlie: looking at recent deploys — nothing in app code. There was an infra change 09:58 UTC that touched LB/Envoy config (rolling push of route weight adjustments + retry/circuit_breaker changes).

brian: I can pull the envoy config dump from the admin endpoint. Paging @dani for oncall help.

dani: taking. jumping in now. Any customer-visible outages reported?

alice: some external customers reported request failures and increased latencies; incident severity P1 due to production impact. Customer success team notified.

charlie: envoy admin cluster config snippet that looks suspicious:

```yaml
clusters:
  - name: inference-backend
    circuit_breakers:
      thresholds:
        - max_connections: 1000
          max_pending_requests: 1024
          max_requests: 100
          max_retries: 3
    common_http_protocol_options:
      idle_timeout: 1s
    retry_policy:
      retry_on: "5xx,connect,reset"
      num_retries: 5
```

brian: notice the retry_policy is set globally with 5 retries + retry_on 5xx. That can amplify failures if upstream is already overloaded. Also idle_timeout 1s is low for longer model responses.

alice: evidence of retry amplification in logs (retries chained):

```
[2025-11-12T10:33:12Z] upstream_rq: 200 -> 503
[2025-11-12T10:33:12Z] envoy retrying -> new request
[2025-11-12T10:33:12Z] upstream_rq: 503 -> 503
[2025-11-12T10:33:12Z] retry budget used
```

dani: plan: 1) quick mitigation to stop retry amplification (set num_retries=0 or disable retry_on 5xx on gateway), 2) widen circuit_breaker thresholds temporarily so healthy backends don't get dropped, 3) rollback the 09:58 LB change if needed.

charlie: I can push a patch to reduce retry_on to "connect,reset" only. Wary of changing circuit breakers without assessment.

deploy-bot: rollback candidate: infra/lb-config@main (deploy id: deploy-20251112-0958). Manual rollback requires approvals from infra-team.

brian: lets do targeted config patch instead of full rollback. Patch content (applied to gateway CDS):

```yaml
retry_policy:
  retry_on: "connect,reset"
  num_retries: 0
```

alice: applying to 10% of gateway instances first as canary, then ramp. I'll push a canary to the longest tail hosts.

charlie: rolling patch via /admin/config/push - scope: api-gateway-canary

```
POST /admin/config/push
{ "scope": "api-gateway-canary", "file": "gateway-retry-fix.yaml" }
```

observability-bot: Canary metrics after 2 minutes:
- canary: 5xx down from 22% -> 3.2%
- main fleet still at 17%

dani: good signal. Schedule ramp to 50% then 100% over next 5 minutes if canary holds. Notify infra for circuit_breaker follow-ups.

brian: ramping to 50%.

(3 minutes pass)

observability-bot: 50% rollout metrics:
- fleet 5xx: 12%
- canary hosts stable

alice: continue to 100%.

(4 minutes pass)

observability-bot: 100% rollout complete. Global 5xx rate down to 2.1% and trending down. Latency back near baseline.

dani: mitigation successful. Root cause likely the aggressive retry_on 5xx + num_retries=5 introduced in 09:58 infra push. That produced retry amplification when a subset of upstreams returned 503s under load. Also idle_timeout too low may have cut model responses causing more resets.

charlie: immediate actions (mitigated):
- disabled 5xx retries on gateway (rolled to 100%)
- left circuit_breaker thresholds as-is for now but flagged for review
- increased idle_timeout to 15s on a follow-up PR (staged)

brian: customer impact note: a subset of traffic experienced 5xx/timeout between ~10:32 and 10:40 UTC (peak), approx 8 minutes. Post-mitigation errors returned to normal. I'll prepare a brief customer-facing summary for CS.

alice: creating incident ticket and assigning to infra/runtime to do deeper RCA. We need to review rollout gating for LB config changes (canary %, automated metric checks) and avoid global retry_on 5xx defaults.

dani: I'm handing off monitoring & follow-up to the night oncall (dani). I'll stay on for 10 more minutes for context then drop into the incident postmortem doc.

deploy-bot: created rollback task (if needed) and incident ticket INC-20251112-081 (linked).

charlie: notes for RCA: capture envoy admin dumps from before/after patch, track which hosts reported 503s, check if any backend scaling events coincided, review the infra change that introduced retry config.

alice: final status: mitigation complete, P1 -> P2, customers notified, postmortem scheduled.

dani: thanks all. Handoff complete — monitoring remains on.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigation acknowledged. Please update INC-20251112-081 with timeline and owners.

(End of thread)
